registryEntry.label: Onboard Windows Devices to Defender for Endpoint via Intune
registryEntry.set_command: $created = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations' -Body (@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.windowsDefenderAdvancedThreatProtectionConfiguration';displayName='CMMC-MDE-Onboarding';description='CMMC L2: onboard devices to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (EDR and Defender Vulnerability Management)';allowSampleSharing=$true;enableExpeditedTelemetryReporting=$true} | ConvertTo-Json) -ContentType 'application/json'; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations/$($created.id)/assign" -Body (@{assignments=@(@{target=@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.groupAssignmentTarget';groupId='{cuiGroupId}'}})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) -ContentType 'application/json' | Out-Null; $created | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
